column3: Overview prose: "This Verilog-AMS Hardware Description Language (HDL) language reference manual defines a behavioral language ..."; every sentence describes the language ("It supports conservative and signal-flow descriptions ..."), none is a requirement. CLAUSE-AUDIT §5.6 lists "the §1.x overview prose" as non-normative.

Definitions ("A system is considered to be a collection of interconnected components ..."; "A signal is a hierarchical collection of nets ...") and one positive property: "the analog portion of an analog or mixed signal is represented by only a single node". No "shall", "shall not", "error" or "illegal" in the clause. Positive evidence that runs and asserts: ch01_intro/lrm_1_3.va (a signal's potential is the same at both levels of a port connection, CHECKX).

The one normative sentence is positive: "The flow is shared so flow from all continuous ports and nets at a node shall sum to zero (0)" — an obligation on the solver's equations (KFL), which no source text can violate; the rest defines potential, flow and branch. Positive evidence that runs and asserts: ch01_intro/01_conservative_resistor.va (branch potential is the node difference, CHECKX), ch01_intro/05_potential_and_flow.va.

Definitions of sign: "the branch potential is positive whenever the potential of the port marked with a plus sign (A) is larger ..."; "Verilog-AMS HDL uses associated reference directions. A positive flow enters a branch through the port marked with the plus sign". Nothing forbidden. Positive evidence that runs and asserts: ch01_intro/03_named_branch.va (V(b,a) == -V(a,b)), ch01_intro/23_flow_antisymmetry.va (I(n,p) == -I(p,n)).

States the laws the simulator uses: "Kirchhoff's Flow Law (KFL) The algebraic sum of all flows out of a node at any instant is zero (0)." and "Kirchhoff's Potential Law (KPL) The algebraic sum of all the branch potentials around a loop at any instant is zero (0)." Properties of the solution, not restrictions on input. Positive evidence that runs and asserts: ch01_intro/25_kpl_loop.va (Figure 1-3's signed four-branch sum, CHECKX), ch01_intro/08_series_potentials.va.

Conventions used in this document: "The formal syntax of Verilog-AMS HDL is described using Backus-Naur Form (BNF). The following conventions are used: ..." — typography of the document (boldface red, blue, brackets, braces), not of the language.
Contents: "This document contains the following clauses and annexes:" followed by one-line summaries of each clause.
